correctness.rationale: PASS: The increasing smooth interior conjugacy h(t)=sin²(pi t/2) converts the sign observation to tent-map threshold 2/3. The Markov refinement A=[0,1/2], B=[1/2,2/3], C=[2/3,1] has edges A→ABC, B→C, C→AB, so every C-to-C return of length k>=2 avoiding intermediate C has exactly two inverse branches C A^(k-1) C and C A^(k-2) B C. Their equal contraction 2^-k yields exactly 2^j equal-length, disjoint-interior cylinders after j returns; upper covers and the fair-branch Frostman measure give dimension lim j/n_j=p (including p=0). Countably many forbidden threshold preimages do not change dimension, and h preserves dimensions by countable compact interior exhaustion. Lebesgue tent ergodicity gives typical C frequency 1/3; the stationary two-state Markov transitions and entropy rate follow directly. Independent enumeration verified both first-return paths for every k=2,...,30. The infinite-fiber dimension is established analytically, not from finite enumeration.
